name: Miku
source:
The oldest of the cat girls, Miku is Antique Kitty’s ‘big sister’ and knows all the ins and outs of running the cafe. Moving at her own pace, Miku is passionate about looking after her customers and fellow staff… when she isn’t sleeping.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1468203843687174145?s=20&t=egJmwdCpdWbznowVJ61ICA]official Twitter[/url]]
